notes.title: A little contest for Twitch Streamers
notes.notes:
- Are you a Twitch streamer?
- Do you enjoy horror games?
- Do you enjoy Welcome to the Game?

If you answered yes to these three questions then I am proud to announce a special contest to you... 

- What do I win?
  The winner of the contest will be given 10 keys of         Welcome to the Game(1) to give away to their community, but ALSO will be given an ADVANCE EARLY COPY of Welcome to the Game II to stream for their community before any one else! Oh.. and 10 keys of Welcome to the Game II to give away as well!

- How do I win?
  The first person to clip and send me via Twitter or Twitch of you getting ALL THREE endings of Welcome to the Game will be the winner! 

RULES:
- You must have at least 500 followers on Twitch.
- Twitch integration has to be OFF
- Must CLIP the moment of you getting to each ending.
- When taking this clip be sure to have the NOTES with KEYS visible on screen.
- Each ending you have to START A NEW GAME.(Can’t use the same run for all three)
- Can NOT be an advantaged player.(AKA ones who do speed runs, sorry guys)
- Entries can NOT be from previous streams. 

WHEN:
Starts TONIGHT(10/4) @ 8PM EST

GOOD LUCK

notes.title: 2.1 Update Now Live - Windows Only
notes.notes:
The 2.1 update is now live!

The update only effects people with Windows machines. Unfortunately there is a bug for the Mac build which causes the game to instant crash. So I have to do some research and figure out why its causing the crash. 

But for now all windows users should be able to access the new 2.1 update!

Whats new with the update? Well -

- Huge performance increase. Switch from Forward to Deferred rendering.
- Switch from a hard to soft load from the start, this should address any one with a slower computer who cant get past the initial loading screen.

Since the game is picking up traction on Twitch, I added Twitch integration. With this update the viewers of your stream will be able to interact with game play via chat. How? You Ask? Read below:

To get the OAUTH for Twitch, please use this link here:


https://twitchapps.com/tmi/

Hacker Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will either vote BLACKHAT or WHITEHAT.
If the BLACKHATS win then a random viewer who voted black hat will be picked as the hacker. The hacker will be able to choice the type of attack(DOS, KERNAL or VAPE) and then the difficulty level(1337, SCRIPT, N00B). If the player(you) blocks the hack, the hacker(them) will get timed out depending the skill level they have set.
If the WHITEHATS win, then you will NOT get hacked, and the modem will be instantly reset.

Escalation Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will vote the following options:
KEY – if this wins, you will be given a free random key on your desktop!
KIDNAPPER – If this wins, then the kidnapper will be released early in the game.
BREATHER – If this wins, then the breather will be released early in the game.

Site Load Speed Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will vote if the websites will load in faster or slow for 3 minutes.

Key Cue Alert Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will vote if the website key cue should be longer or disabled!

 Modem Reset Time Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will vote if either the modem reset time will be increased by double or decreased!

Random Spooky Event Poll
This will trigger a poll in which your viewers will vote if there should be a mystery random jump scare event!


I will be monitoring people on Twitch the next few days to see what I could adjust and if anything needs balancing. 

With that being said, I see a lot of people requesting a 'casual' mode.. If I see a steady user play base the next few weeks, I promise I will add the following modes:

Speed Run Mode - This mode will be great for people who would like to do speed runs.

Casual Mode - For those who just want to read the content / lore behind Welcome to the game. Which will disable any ending, kidnapper, hacks and breather.. pretty much a web browser simulator. 

With that being said, if I also sell enough units to support it, I will add a '1337 Mode' Which will be very hard to make. Why 'sell enough units' well with this I would like to add a whole new ending to the game, but can only do if I have the finances to support it!

Hope you guys enjoy this free update, I enjoy seeing everyone still play it when its almost been out for a year now!

- Adam

notes.title: Small Update - Read
notes.notes:
Alright, 

Since only about 0.2% ownership has beat the game. I went ahead and made a small update to this game. 

The update includes a hidden cue / clue when you visit a page that contains a key. Could it be a sound cue? A visual cue? or something else entirely? Who knows.. I guess you guys will have to figure that out :)

This update also now deletes your game file once you have beat the game, so you can NOT get all the endings with one run. 

I will see how this update plays out, and do any future updates that I see fit. Hopefully this update wont make the game too easy.

notes.title: 2.0 Official Launch Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Game 2.0 is now finally here! and there is quite a bit that has been added!

+ 3rd New mini puzzle / V.A.P.E attack
+ 30+ new deep web pages to explore so now over 50+ pages.
+ Forgive me now takes your own confessions, so you can submit them via the site.
+ Now when you browse Forgive Me you are reading live confessions from other players.
+ Added a new mechanic to prevent being hacked, reseting the modem. 
+ Brand new Breather mechanics. 
+ Explore the front door.
+ 3rd deep wiki.
+ New puzzle site.
+ Pages are now even deeper when you explore, no more ‘page can not be displayed’ for every sub page.
+ Reduced loading time.. just a slight bit. 
+ Re-did the tutorial with a better voice over.
+ Gate Keeper has been updated to fit the new content.
+ Revised Chosen Awake puzzle site.
+ Now when you try to visit pages that are not up, they won’t be highlight purple. This will help you keep better track of where you have not yet been.
+ Steam achievements.
+ Easter eggs.
+ 2 Secret endings
+ Fixed minor bugs, including the audio un-muting its self.
+ Optimized performance greatly to have it run better on lower end machines.
+ Nudity setting, will be off by default, must be turned on if you want to opt in.

On top of all of this, we are now proud to announce the ‘Hacker Mode’ DLC. Now available. 

Welcome to the Game - Hacker Mode is a DLC for Welcome to the Game that is a non-stop chain puzzle mode. Solve your favorite attacks from the DOSBlocker, K3RN3LC0MP1L3R and new CLOUDGRID. Each chain mode has levels of chains, as you progress further the puzzles get more difficult. Solve them to get points! 

Build up points to compile stacks, use those stacks unlock upgrades! Upgrades include: 

- NOPSled: Will instantly progress you to the next chain level. 
- Shell: Will recover you from a failed hack attempt, AKA extra hacker life! 
- DOS_TURBO: Permanently increase boost time! 
- KernSKIP: Will instantly skip the current line of code in the K3RN3LC0MP1L3R. 
- cloudFREEZE: Freezes time in a current cloud grid for 30 seconds. 


Thank you all for who have been patient on this update, took me a little bit longer then I was excepting, but I am sure you guys will be happy with the results.

If you have any bugs or issues, please be sure to post them in the bug report thread in the discussions. 

- Adam

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.1
notes.notes:
This is a quick update to address the following:

If you are experiencing a crash right when the game starts to load, now goto the options menu and hit OFF for the MIC options. I found out that in certain windows machines it was causing issues when trying to tap into your mic. Also you can use this option to disable the mic mechanic for the kidnapper. 

I went ahead and also changed the sprite / 2D elements not to be effected by changing the texture quality settings. So when you change the quality level, it should stay the same for the sprite / 2D elements of the game .
